- `/opt/builder/app.py` — stdlib-only `ThreadingHTTPServer` on `0.0.0.0:8080`
- `GET /health` → `200 ready`
- `PUT /records/<id>` → `204`; atomic write (tmp → fsync → rename → dir fsync)

- Records live in `/var/lib/builder/records/` on `/dev/vda` (ext4, rw) — survives reboot
- `builder-app.service` is `enabled` with `Restart=always` — auto-starts on boot, no agent needed
